title: Extension-Cost Points in the Appraisal Order Late-Rush Refund
content:
The extension-cost points of the Appraisal Order late-rush refund read the rate lock on the same loan file and total the lock costs the borrower still bears there, that is the extension costs booked to the borrower on that lock less every lock-cost waiver booked on that lock: lock costs still borne of 500 dollars or more add 10 percentage points, more than zero and under 500 dollars add 5 points, and nothing still borne adds nothing. The lock read is the Rate Lock Commitment on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports; its extension entries whose cost the borrower bears are totalled, and every lock-cost waiver booked on that lock is taken off that total, whatever cost the waiver concerns. The points are added to the percentage on which the refund share of the late-rush refund is built, and the refund share, with the points added, is never more than 100 percent and never less than zero.

| Lock costs the borrower still bears on the Rate Lock Commitment (extension costs booked to the borrower less every lock-cost waiver on that lock) | Points |
|---|---|
| 500.00 dollars or more | 10 |
| More than 0.00 and under 500.00 dollars | 5 |
| 0.00 or less | 0 |

**Hypothetical lock histories.**
- Two extensions booked to the borrower at 312.50 each, no waiver: 625.00 still borne, 10 points.
- One extension booked to the borrower at 312.50 and a waiver of 312.50: nothing borne, no points.
- One extension booked to the borrower at 187.50, no waiver: 187.50 still borne, 5 points.
- One extension booked to the borrower at 312.50 and a waiver of 100.00 of another cost on that lock: 212.50 still borne, 5 points.
- Extensions whose cost Larkspur bears only: nothing borne by the borrower, no points.
